Two facts make importing Claude's coupling actively unsafe here: the sandbox is opt-in and **default off** (`storage.ts:1124 getMacosSeatbeltBashSandboxEnabled()` → `?? false`, read at `claude-agent.ts:1319` and `pi-agent.ts:3801`), and the shipped profile is currently a wildcard — `bash-seatbelt.ts:87 SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD: boolean = true` returns `(allow default)` under a dated owner decision (2026-07-21, reaffirmed 2026-07-29). The "only" list erases `allowUnsandboxedCommands`, which is itself a documented Claude sandbox key we **do** implement (`:75`, boolean-AND across layers).
correctedState:
`autoAllowBashIfSandboxed` has no reader in `.ts` source (5 grep hits exist, all in gitignored build bundles), and this is a recorded deviation, not a gap. The decision is dated 2026-07-29 in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-29-deviation-unit-5.md:115` and harvested into `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:64`: the key's documented default is conditioned on `sandbox.enabled`, an opt-in whose Nessy analogue is architecturally different, so no key was added rather than shipping a settable-but-unread one.

The right subsystem is the Bash permission path, not `config/sandbox-settings.ts` (that file governs supervised-process isolation via `ProcessSupervisor`). In `packages/shared/src/agent/core/pre-tool-use.ts:1475-1476`, the macOS seatbelt wrapper is applied at step 5h with the explicit invariant that "Permission and prompt decisions use the original command, while actual execution receives this wrapped form" — sandbox status is deliberately not an input to the prompt decision. The sandbox is additionally opt-in and default-off (`config/storage.ts:1124`, `?? false`), and its profile is currently `(allow default)` under a live owner decision (`agent/core/bash-seatbelt.ts:87`, `SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD = true`, 2026-07-21, reaffirmed 2026-07-29). Adopting Claude's default-`true` coupling would therefore auto-approve every Bash command behind a sandbox that presently permits everything.

Our sandbox settings schema is `excludedCommands`, `deniedReadRoots`, `deniedWriteRoots`, `additionalWritableRoots`, `allowUnsandboxedCommands`, `network.{deniedDomains, allowedDomains, allowManagedDomainsOnly}` and `filesystem.{disabled, allowRead, allowManagedReadPathsOnly}` (`sandbox-settings.ts:172-183`) — including `allowUnsandboxedCommands`, a documented Claude sandbox key that is implemented.
